edges.reason: block.timestamp gates the new startTime and enforces _start > block.timestamp.
claim() requires block.timestamp >= startTime, making claimability timestamp dependent.
mint() requires block.timestamp >= startTime, making minting timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is hashed as a randomness seed in _getNewId.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudorandom id seed in _getNewId.
claim() authorizes the caller through IERC721(KONGZ).ownerOf(_tokenId) == msg.sender.
msg.sender is the mint recipient and is checked with _isContract.
changeName uses msg.sender as the ERC20 payer and ownership check via super.changeName.
fetchSaleFunds sends the whole balance to msg.sender under onlyOwner.
startTime state value is read by the claim() time gate.
startTime state value is read by the mint() time gate.
sold participates in currentMinted = sold + minted inside claim().
sold is compared against BUYABLE and incremented by _amount in mint().
minted participates in currentMinted and is incremented in claim().
minted participates in currentMinted = sold + minted inside mint().
availableIds is read and written with index arithmetic (remaining - 1) in the swap-and-pop id picker.
MINTABLE is used for remaining = MINTABLE - _totalMinted and as the modulo bound.
isClaimed reads bebeClaimBitMask for the queried tokenId.
_setClaimed writes the shifted mask into bebeClaimBitMask.
nameChangePrice is used as the ERC20 amount pulled in changeName.
banana address is the target of the external ERC20 transferFrom in changeName.
_tokenName[tokenId] is read/dereserved and overwritten by changeName.
_nameReserved is checked via isNameReserved before the name change.
KONGZ constant provides the external contract address queried in claim.
_owner is the onlyOwner guard for fetchSaleFunds.
claim() invokes the external KONGZ.ownerOf call to authorize the caller.
claim() calls _setClaimed before minting a Bebe token.
claim() calls _getNewId to obtain the new token id.
claim() mints a token using a miner-influenceable pseudorandom id.
mint() calls _getNewId for each token in the loop.
mint() mints tokens whose ids come from weakly random values.
_getNewId produces the value consumed by the minting path.
isClaimed performs division, modulo and bit shift to build the mask.
_setClaimed performs division, modulo and bit shift to build the mask.
changeName performs an external ERC20 transferFrom before the name state is updated.
fetchSaleFunds performs a native transfer to msg.sender after the onlyOwner check.
External ERC20 call hands control to a caller-chosen token contract that may re-enter changeName.
Native transfer to msg.sender can trigger fallback logic re-entering fetchSaleFunds.
External call into the KONGZ contract returns data consumed by claim before it updates state.
_start parameter is written into startTime.
newURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
_banana parameter is written to the banana state variable.
_price parameter is written to nameChangePrice.
_addr parameter is measured with extcodesize.
_tokenId parameter indexes the claim bitmask in isClaimed.
_tokenId parameter indexes the claim bitmask in _setClaimed.
_totalMinted parameter computes remaining inside _getNewId.
_tokenId parameter drives the ownership check and branch selection in claim.
_amount parameter bounds the mint loop and price validation.
tokenId parameter selects the token whose name changes.
newName parameter is validated, reserved and stored.
rand local is the derived pseudorandom index used in _getNewId.
remaining local drives the subtraction and array index arithmetic.
currentMinted local = sold + minted inside claim.
currentMinted local = sold + minted inside mint.
owner local caches ownerOf(tokenId) for the caller authorization check.

normalization_plan.reason: _start is only a write source for startTime inside setStartTime.
newURI is only a passthrough into _setBaseURI inside updateURI.
_banana is only assigned to the banana state variable in setBanana.
_price is only assigned to nameChangePrice in changeNamePrice.
_addr is only inspected with extcodesize in _isContract.
_tokenId is only used to index the claim bitmask in isClaimed.
_tokenId is only used to build and set the claim bit in _setClaimed.
_totalMinted only computes remaining inside _getNewId.
_tokenId is the sole input of claim's ownership and claim-status checks.
_amount only limits the mint loop, price and buyable checks.
tokenId only selects the target token inside changeName.
newName is the payload validated and stored by changeName.
wordIndex is a transient index of the bitmask arithmetic helpers.
bitIndex is a transient index of the bitmask arithmetic helpers.
mask is the transient shift result written into the claim bitmask.
rand exists only to hold the pseudorandom index inside _getNewId.
remaining exists only for the swap-and-pop arithmetic in _getNewId.
currentMinted is a transient sum used only inside claim.
currentMinted is a transient sum used only inside mint.
owner is a transient cache of ownerOf used only inside changeName.
